newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Railcorp May shipments rise.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Railcorp May shipments rise.

text.p: Pioneer Railcorp said Wednesday its May shipments totaled 3,464 carloads, up from 3,175 a year ago.
Pioneer, which operates 14 freight short-line railroads, said its May shipments were the second-highest monthly carloadings for the company. The record was set in April 1997 with 3,551 shipments.
Pioneer said its railroads experienced increased shipments for virtually all of its customers with no decreases in commodities hauled.

Pioneer also reported increases in the number of corn and clay shipped over last month. In May, 81 cars with clay were moved versus 36 cars in April. Similarly, 160 carloads of corn were hauled in May compared to 54 in April.
"Pioneer's continuing monthly increases in carloadings shipped are supportive of our expectations that sales and earnings will improve this year," Guy Brenkman, chairman, said in a statement.
